ns2:section.sectionText: An exploration of fundamental elements of music, free from stylistic considerations and using basic logical and mathematical concepts: from the internal structure of sounds to methods of organizing them into complex compositions. Familiarity with either music or mathematics is NOT required. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. This class was previously taught as MUS 424. Credit will not be given for both this course and MUS 424.
